answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent’s signing identity to a hardware-rooted key and a remotely verified enclave report with an approved MRENCLAVE. Because MRENCLAVE identifies code, not a unique chip, policy must also verify device-bound attestation. A copied VM cannot forge that proof; creating additional independent identities requires provisioned physical silicon, not duplication. Names such as sparrow, canyon, and nebula do not change the trust check.
